title: Drogenerkennung im Straßenverkehr – Bilanz zu Schwerpunktkontrollen im Rahmen der 7. Berliner DiS-Tage

extraction.summaryEn: Police report results of traffic checks on drug driving over 15-17 September 2026 at three Berlin locations, with 1,366 people checked and 68 blood tests ordered. Several drug and assault cases were recorded during the operation.
